name: China Academy of Electronics and Information Technology
zhAliases: 中国电子科技集团公司电子科学研究院

evidence.summary: CETC, a state-owned defence-industry group, lists the academy (中国电子科技集团公司电子科学研究院) among its member units, and the US Entity List entry gives it the alias “CETC CAEIT”.

The US Commerce Department listed it in 2021, finding it implicated in human rights violations and abuses in China’s campaign of repression, mass detention and high-technology surveillance against Uyghurs, Kazakhs and other Muslim minority groups in Xinjiang.
